notes: Modular 1RU multi-window video-wall processor (CORIO3 engine; up to 4 canvases, up to 14 windows/canvas). The chassis has 2 fixed Universal DVI-U inputs plus 5 universal I/O slots (the C3-510 part number is rated "up to 18 inputs" when fully populated) that accept separately-ordered modules: HDMI (incl. 4K), DVI, 3G/HD/SD-SDI, HDBaseT, 4K streaming-media, dual-HDMI keying, and an S/PDIF + analog audio module (CM-AUD-2IN-4OUT) that is NOT included/pictured here since it did not appear in the manufacturer's own rear-panel photo. The graded video-module ports listed (2x 3G-SDI in, 2x HDMI 4K/60 out, 2x HDBaseT out, 1x streaming-media module with GbE+USB3.0) reflect the exact configuration shown in tvOne's own official rear-panel photo on the spec sheet — a real, manufacturer-illustrated example — but actual shipped units vary by which modules a customer orders; treat these as representative, not guaranteed, for any given unit. HDMI output grade (2.0) is inferred from documented 4K60 8-bit support since the sheet never states an HDMI version number. SDI grade (sdi-3g) reflects the explicitly stated SMPTE424M 2.97/2.967Gbps rating; these SDI ports are also backward-compatible to HD-SDI/SD-SDI. Control LAN link speed is not stated. The optional CM-4RPS redundant power supply applies to the larger C3-540 chassis only, not the C3-510. Non-I/O specs confirmed from the same sheet: 1RU (1.77 x 19.0 x 13.25in / 45x482x336mm), ~11 lb, 110-240V 50/60Hz auto-detecting internal PSU, 5-year warranty. Primary source used: tvOne official "C3-510 CORIOmaster mini" Specification Sheet v2.1 (2021), fetched from https://tvone.com/wp-content/uploads/spec-sheets/C3-510.pdf (linked from the manufacturer product page https://tvone.com/products/video-wall-processors/c3-510).

ports.name: DVI-U Input 1
ports.note: Fixed Universal DVI input (always present, not a module). HDMI & HDCP compatible via DVI-D; accepts analog RGBHV/RGBS/RGsB/YPbPr, composite and S-Video via optional DVI-I breakout adapters.

ports.name: DVI-U Input 2
ports.note: Fixed Universal DVI input, same capability as DVI-U Input 1.

ports.name: 3G-SDI Input 1
ports.note: Populated via optional CM-3GSDI-2IN dual 3G/HD/SD-SDI input module; SMPTE424M 2.97/2.967Gbps rating stated in spec sheet. Shown in tvOne's own rear-panel photo but is a separately-ordered module, not guaranteed on every unit.

ports.name: HDMI 4K/60 Output 1
ports.note: Populated via optional CM-HDMI-4K-SC-2OUT module (dual 4K30 or single 4K60). Spec sheet does not state an HDMI version number; 2.0 is inferred from documented 4K60 8-bit output support.

ports.name: HDBaseT Output 1
ports.note: Populated via optional CM-HDBT-SC-2OUT dual HDBaseT output module (with scaling).

ports.name: 4K Streaming Media Input – Ethernet
ports.note: AV-over-IP module (CM-AVIP-IN-1USB-1ETH), 1x GbE port per spec table for stream in/decoder and FTP media transfer.

ports.name: 4K Streaming Media Input – USB
ports.note: USB 3.0 port on the same AV-over-IP/media module, for local file playback from flash media.

ports.name: LAN
ports.note: Base-unit control/IP interface (RJ45) for CORIOgrapher software, REST API and HTTP(S) control. Link speed not stated in the spec sheet.

ports.name: USB
ports.note: Front-panel USB 3.0 interface (visible in product photos); supports FAT/FAT32/ext3/ext4/NTFS flash media, works with up to 128GB internal storage.

ports.name: AC Power In
ports.note: 100–240V 50/60Hz auto-sensing, 1.6A max, IEC inlet with rocker power switch.
